Trade Kings Group is a Zambian privately owned fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) and manufacturing company founded in 1995 and headquartered in Lusaka, Zambia. The company produces a range of household, personal care, food, and beverage products distributed across parts of Sub-Saharan Africa.
As of the 2020s, Trade Kings operates manufacturing facilities in Zambia and Zimbabwe and exports products to several African countries. According to reports, the company employs more than 17,000 people and has made investments exceeding US$1 billion.
The company’s product portfolio includes brands in detergents, beverages, confectionery, and dairy products.
History
Trade Kings Group was founded in 1995 by Mohamed Iqbal Patel in Lusaka, initially producing detergent products. The company later expanded into additional product categories, including soaps and confectionery in the late 1990s.
During the 2000s, the company expanded its operations beyond Zambia, including entry into the South African market and the establishment of manufacturing capacity there.
In 2008, the group commissioned Kafue Steel Mills, a facility involved in steel production in Zambia.
In 2018, Trade Kings commissioned a detergent manufacturing plant in the Lusaka South Multi-Facility Economic Zone.
Subsidiaries
BigTree Beverages
BigTree Beverages is a subsidiary of Trade Kings Group established in 2016. The company produces soft drinks, energy drinks, and other beverages for regional markets.
In 2022, the company invested approximately US$80 million in a beverage production facility located in the Lusaka South Multi-Facility Economic Zone.
KingsWorth Group Limited
KingsWorth Group Limited (KGL) is a subsidiary of Trade Kings Group involved in starch and glucose production.
In October 2025, the company commissioned a glucose and starch manufacturing facility in the Lusaka South Multi-Facility Economic Zone. The plant processes maize into products such as glucose, starch, and related by-products.
